items.title: aiXcoder：AI并非软件开发的“银弹”，需与软件工程结合
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，硅心科技（aiXcoder）产品研发负责人黄宁受邀出席CSDN和奇点智能研究院联合主办的“全球C++及系统软件技术大会”，并发表《超越vibe coding，构建以人为主的可靠开发流程》主题演讲，与来自腾讯、阿里、百度等企业的领域专家共同探讨大模型驱动的软件开发现状及未来。 黄宁认为，Vibe Coding模式虽然在特定场景下展现出高效的生成能力，但却难以适配企业级复杂项目开发。AI并非软件开发的“银弹”，需要与软件工程相结合，构建集能力扩展与行为监测于一体的可靠AI研发流程，确保软件交付质量的可控、可预测与高效落地。   图：硅心科技（aiXcoder）产品研发负责人黄宁 企业级应用场景下，AI开发模式的挑战与思考 随着大模型能力提升，“通过自然语言指令让AI生成符合特定风格代码”的Vibe Coding开发模式日渐兴起，其核心特征是将代码细节几乎全部交由AI生成，人仅聚焦需求描述与最终结果。 然而，aiXcoder在工程实践和与企业的交流中发现，Vibe Coding模式直接应用于企业级项目会暴漏出诸多问题：AI生成的代码常忽略企业既有工具函数，擅自增加独立模块，追求“当下问题解决”而不顾后期维护，甚至因缺失安全校验留下漏洞隐患，增加代码评审负担。 深层原因在于，企业级复杂项目往往承载着长期的迭代需求，沉淀了大量隐性规则和多年维护的考量。而AI缺乏人类工程师的“吃亏经验”——无法预判未来需求变化、推演潜在风险，只能给出“局部最优解”，难以满足工程所需的“全局稳定性和未来可扩展性”要求。   图：Vibe Coding在企业级环境“水土不服”的原因分析 aiXcoder“AI+软件工程”实践路径 面对企业级智能化软件开发提效需求，aiXcoder秉承“围绕AI能力范围设计系统、确立开发者为项目最终责任主体、学习与传承软件知识”三大AI软件工程原则

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 24, Tencent Cloud's official account disclosed that over 60% of China's TOP 10 securities firms have chosen Tencent Cloud to build a new generation of domestic big data platforms, supporting the upgrade of data infrastructure for the AI era. This shift is becoming a new trend in the securities industry. Over the past decade, traditional big data platforms represented by CDH have long supported securities firms' data analysis and business decisions, primarily for scenarios like report statistics and batch computing. However, as wealth management evolves toward intelligence, scenarios such as robo-advisors, intelligent marketing, AI risk control, and real-time monitoring are gradually becoming the norm, significantly increasing the demand for "always-available" data. Meanwhile, data fragmentation issues caused by long-term system layering have become increasingly prominent, with large amounts of unstructured data—such as research reports, financial statements, investment banking drafts, and announcements—struggling to be effectively integrated into analysis, hindering the implementation of high-value applications. Additionally, the gradual retirement and discontinuation of traditional commercial distributions like CDH have intensified the pressure on securities firms to upgrade their data foundations. There is a widespread consensus in the industry that the original architecture can no longer support the next phase of development. Against this backdrop, an increasing number of leading securities firms are advancing the construction of new-generation data platforms. According to Tencent Cloud's disclosure, several top institutions, including CITIC Securities, Guotai Haitong, GF Securities, Galaxy Securities, China Securities, and CICC Wealth, have already partnered with Tencent Cloud's big data platform, TBDS. excerpt_i18n.es: El 24 de diciembre, el canal oficial de Tencent Cloud reveló que entre las 10 principales empresas de valores de China, más del 60% han optado por Tencent Cloud para construir una nueva generación de plataforma de big data nacional, destinada a respaldar la actualización de la infraestructura de datos para la era de la IA. Este cambio se está convirtiendo en una nueva tendencia en la industria de valores. Durante más de una década, las plataformas tradicionales de big data, representadas por CDH, han respaldado el análisis de datos y la toma de decisiones operativas de las empresas de valores, principalmente en escenarios como estadísticas de informes y cálculos por lotes. Sin embargo, con la evolución de la gestión patrimonial hacia la inteligencia, escenarios como el asesoramiento de inversión inteligente, el marketing inteligente, el control de riesgos con IA y la supervisión en tiempo real se han vuelto gradualmente comunes, aumentando significativamente la demanda de datos "disponibles en cualquier momento".

items.title: 郭毅可院士：AI带来「知识通胀」，击碎了传统教育的「前提假设」丨GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 12月12日， 第八届 GAIR 全球人工智能与机器人大会于深圳正式拉开帷幕。 本次大会为期两天，由GAIR研究院与雷峰网联合主办，高文院士任指导委员会主席，杨强院士与朱晓蕊教授任大会主席。 作为 AI 产学研投界标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守 “传承+创新” 内核，是 AI 学界思想接力的阵地、技术交流的平台，更是中国 AI 四十年发展的精神家园。过去四年大模型驱动 AI 产业加速变革，岁末年初 GAIR 如约而至，以高质量观点碰撞，为行业与大众呈现AI时代的前沿洞见。 本次峰会之上， 中国工程院外籍院士、英国皇家工程院院士、香港科技大学首席副校长郭毅可校长 亲临现场，为与会者们带来了一场精彩纷呈的开场报告。 深耕学界多年的他，见证了AI与高等教育的演进交汇。他从生成式AI重塑“知识获取方式”谈起，指出当下教育的对象已经不仅是孩子，也包括机器，而两者之间存在着意想不到的共性。借此，他引出了对“教育范式即将转向”的思考： 1、所有的教育，都基于一个基本假设：知识的稀缺性。但今天，大语言模型带来了知识的通货膨胀，本来的黄金变成了空气，教育和学习还有意义吗？ 2、知识是具有共识的认知。而大语言模型是大量互联网信息的压缩，是统计学意义上的共识。 3、学习有两个意义：理解世界（客观建模），理解自己（价值建模）。现在的核心挑战是：机器在客观建模上已经开始超越人类。 4、当前AI在身份建模上能力仍显薄弱。核心问题在于，身份模型具有个性化属性，而强化学习所依赖的反馈却是偏向共性化的，因此，人性与人格的培育或将成为我们后续教育行业发展的关键。 5、人工智能时代的教育，应从“知识传输”，转为培养学生的能力、好奇心、学习主动性和共创意识。 6、不要老是担忧AI会替代我们，而要把自己解放出来。尤其教育者，要对AI保持乐观：如果学生还能用AI作弊，那就说明考试方式本身出了问题。

items.title: 深圳理工大学唐志敏：异构计算已成必然，软件决定芯片胜负 ｜GAIR 2025
items.raw_excerpt: 作者｜包永刚 编辑｜林觉民 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 深圳理工大学算力微电子学院院长、龙芯 CPU 与海光 CPU 创始人唐志敏发表了题为《XPU的未来——软件决定成败》的主题演讲。 唐老师指出，算力不仅是硬件性能的体现，更是一种在资源与时间约束下完成任务的能力体系。在这一背景下，训力、推力等新型算力能力正在逐步形成，推动人工智能从语言理解向多模态生成发展。 他强调，随着生成式 AI 对算力需求的快速增长，单靠 CPU 已无法满足现实需求，异构计算（CPU+XPU）成为必然选择。但硬件本身并非决定因素，真正影响算力释放的，是软件与应用生态。他通过对x86、Arm和RISC-V的分析，指出生态惯性和软件兼容性在商业化和技术落地中起到决定性作用，生态成熟度往往比硬件性能更能决定芯片成败。 唐志敏也强调，软件定义一切，这不仅意味着应用开发与性能优化，更决定了算力芯片的长期竞争力和产业格局。 在算力体系演进中，硬件是基础，但软件和生态才是真正的“决定因素”。无论是 CPU、GPU 还是未来的 XPU，掌握和构建完整的软件生态，才能在高速增长的算力需求与复杂的技术挑战中立于不败之地。 以下为唐志敏老师的精彩演讲内容，雷峰网作了不改变原意的整理与编辑： 从“算力”到 Computility：算力正在被重新定义 “算力”其实是中国人

On December 12–13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel.  
As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment sphere, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice.  
At a time when artificial intelligence is increasingly becoming a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power: The Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China’s AI industry over the next decade.  
Tang Zhimin, Dean of the Computing Power Microelectronics School at Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology and founder of Loongson CPU and Hygon CPU, delivered a keynote speech titled "The Future of XPU—Software Determines Success or Failure."

He emphasized that with the rapid growth in computing power demand driven by generative AI, relying solely on CPUs can no longer meet practical needs, making heterogeneous computing (CPU + XPU) an inevitable choice. excerpt_i18n.en: With the new generation open-source in-memory database Valkey rapidly maturing in the global community, the landscape of open-source foundational software is undergoing significant changes. On December 23, Tencent Cloud announced it was the first in China to support and release Valkey 8.0, while also ranking first globally in community code contributions, becoming a key force driving the project toward production-level applications. Valkey is an open-source in-memory key-value database project hosted by the Linux Foundation and originating from the Redis community, dedicated to building a vendor-neutral, long-term stable foundational software platform through permissive open-source licensing and community governance. Kyle Davis, the open-source lead for Valkey, stated that Valkey has rediscovered the original intent of the open-source community, and the continuous investment from cloud providers like Tencent Cloud has laid a solid foundation for the project's long-term sustainable development. Currently, leading global cloud providers such as AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle, Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and Huawei Cloud are deeply involved in the Valkey community, forming an open-source collaboration model centered around the community. The Valkey China community has also been established in Beijing, with Chinese developers actively participating in global community governance. As one of the founding members of the Valkey community, Tencent Cloud is deeply involved in the project's development, continuously feeding back large-scale cloud business practices to the community and contributing significant core code in areas such as cluster scaling, performance optimization, and stability enhancement. excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que la nueva generación de base de datos en memoria de código abierto Valkey madura rápidamente en la comunidad global, el panorama del software básico de código abierto está experimentando cambios significativos. El 23 de diciembre, Tencent Cloud anunció que fue el primero en China en ofrecer soporte y lanzar la versión 8.0 de Valkey, al tiempo que se posicionó como líder mundial en contribuciones de código a la comunidad, convirtiéndose en una fuerza clave para impulsar el proyecto hacia aplicaciones de nivel productivo. Valkey es un proyecto de base de datos en memoria clave-valor de código abierto, alojado por la Linux Foundation y originado en la comunidad Redis, que se dedica a construir una plataforma de software básico neutral para proveedores, estable y a largo plazo, mediante un protocolo de código abierto permisivo y un modelo de gobernanza comunitaria.

excerpt_i18n.en:
For a long time, climate, weather, and Earth system research have relied almost entirely on numerical simulations. Supercomputers are tasked with solving physical equations layer by layer, where the precision, resolution, and stability of the models determine how much of the natural system humans can "see clearly." In recent years, with changes in computing power, artificial intelligence has increasingly been introduced into these traditional fields. Particularly in climate and Earth system modeling, AI is held with high expectations: can it fill in the details that numerical models struggle to cover? Can it provide a finer view of the system under limited computing power? These questions are becoming unavoidable discussions in the fields of supercomputing and scientific computing.

Earth system models represent one of the most typical scenarios in this regard. From global circulation to local weather, from oceans to the atmosphere, and from kilometer-scale to finer variations, the processes these models need to handle are extremely complex and nearly impossible to fully exhaust. Precisely because of this, academia and engineering circles have maintained a cautious, even divided, attitude toward how AI should be integrated into Earth system modeling.

At the GAIR 2025 conference, discussions on the relationship between artificial intelligence and scientific computing were once again brought into focus. Professor Fu Haohuan shared insights during the event, exploring the boundaries and possibilities between numerical simulation and AI in the context of Earth system models and supercomputing practices. Los superordenadores se encargaban de procesar ecuaciones físicas capa por capa, donde la precisión, resolución y estabilidad de los modelos determinaban cuánto podía "verse" del sistema natural.
